name: Scriptery
tagline: What it does Scriptery turns any video or audio into clean, timestamped text in seconds
description: What it does Scriptery turns any video or audio into clean, timestamped text in seconds. Paste a public link from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, Reddit, Facebook, Vimeo, SoundCloud, Twitch or RedNote, or upload your own file, and get an accurate transcript powered by OpenAI's Whisper. Key benefits - Export to TXT, SRT or VTT for notes, subtitles and captions - Every line timestamped, with no sign-up and a free daily quota - Runs in the browser, with the interface available in nine languages
